channel.title: OpEdNews (OEN) – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from OpEdNews (OEN) – Bias and Credibility (fullfact.org)

item.title: Video shows US warehouse explosion not delayed missile detonation in Israel – Full Fact
item.description: A video circulating online with false claims it depicts an Iranian missile exploding in Tel Aviv is actually old footage of a 2016 warehouse fire in California.

item.title: The Maldives cut diplomatic relations with Israel in 1974, not recently – Full Fact
item.description: Social media posts with ‘breaking news’ banners incorrectly suggest the Maldives has recently “cut all ties with Israel” and banned Israeli products.

item.title: Meningitis B: your questions answered – Full Fact
item.description: We answer questions from Full Fact readers, including why everyone doesn’t get the vaccine, and how long protection from the vaccine lasts.

item.title: Fake crash picture shared with false claims it shows satellite brought down by Iranian missile – Full Fact
item.description: A fake AI-generated image is being shared with false claims that Iranian missiles brought down a US-Israeli spy satellite. There are no reports of this happening.

item.title: Keir Starmer didn’t say the UK ‘may need to go into lockdown’ if meningitis cases keep rising – Full Fact
item.description: Number 10 confirmed Sir Keir Starmer did not say the UK may need to go into another lockdown if meningitis cases continue to rise.

item.title: What was Exercise Pegasus and does it have anything to do with the current Meningitis B outbreak? – Full Fact
item.description: Posts online suggest there’s some sort of conspiracy involving a 2025 pandemic simulation exercise and the meningitis outbreak, but there’s absolutely no evidence to support this.

item.title: The government finally corrects its misleading sunbeds claim – Full Fact
item.description: Following our fact check, it has stopped saying sunbeds are “as dangerous as smoking”.

item.title: Footage doesn’t show attack on the King Fahd causeway – Full Fact
item.description: The footage is actually from October 2022 and shows an explosion on the Kerch bridge, linking Russia and Crimea.

item.title: Video shows queue for fuel in Spain, not UK – Full Fact
item.description: A video shared on social media with claims about long queues at petrol stations in the UK actually shows scenes from Seville in Spain.

item.title: Fake image of Jewish charity ambulances on fire shared online – Full Fact
item.description: An AI-generated image of the incident, which saw four ambulances belonging to a Jewish community ambulance service set on fire in the early hours of Monday morning, has been posted on social media.
